package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 7
	p := &x
	fmt.Println(*p)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 3
	p := &x
	*p = 9
	fmt.Println(x)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	a := [2]int{1, 2}
	b := a
	p := &a
	b[0] = 9
	p[1] = 8
	fmt.Println(a[0])
	fmt.Println(a[1])
	fmt.Println(b[1])
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 4
	p := &x
	q := &p
	**q = 6
	fmt.Println(x)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 5
	p := &x
	*p++
	fmt.Println(x)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	a, b := 1, 2
	p, q := &a, &b
	*p, *q = *q, *p
	fmt.Println(a)
	fmt.Println(b)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x, y := 3, 8
	p := &x
	p = &y
	*p = 1
	fmt.Println(x)
	fmt.Println(y)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 4
	p := &x
	q := p
	*q = 7
	fmt.Println(*p)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 10
	p := &x
	q := &x
	*p = 2
	fmt.Println(*q)
}
